Two weekly rotations, `primary` and `secondary`, with the same four members and `min_distance=1sl` each, joined by a mutual `repel!` row in `#Global` from the start and built by weekly runs over three months. The rest window is `D = (1sl + 1sl) / 2 = 1w`, so whoever holds a `primary` week is kept off `secondary` for that week and the week before and after it, and the same the other way round. With four members that pins the pattern down: for a `secondary` week the holders of the current and the previous `primary` week are out, `secondary`'s own `min_distance` removes last week's holder, and one member is left, so `secondary` runs two weeks behind `primary` (primary alice, carol, bob, dave; secondary bob, dave, alice, carol) with no relaxation and no notes. The snapshots on 09-07 show the mirrored scores (primary alice 28, bob 21, carol 28, dave 21; secondary alice 21, bob 28, carol 21, dave 28) and `expected/status.txt` marks the pair `-!` in the relations matrix and shows in `#All shifts` that a member's two roles are always at least two weeks apart.
